summary: National Fuel Gas Company filed an 8-K reporting its election to exercise optional redemption rights to redeem all $300M of its 5.50% Notes due October 2026, with a redemption date of June 11, 2026. The redemption price will be calculated per the indenture terms. The trustee, The Bank of New York Mellon, issued a conditional redemption notice. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation, with no equity event, no premium over market, and no structural complexity. Filing is vanilla financing activity.
